movelist.name: Discharge
movelist.effect: Discharge Paralyzes all legal targets on 15+.

movelist.name: Nature’s Madness
movelist.effect: The target loses 1/2 of their current Hit Points.

movelist.name: Mirror Move
movelist.effect: Use the Move the target has used on their last turn. You may choose new targets for the Move. Mirror Move cannot miss.

movelist.name: Charge
movelist.effect: If the user performs an Electric Move on their next turn that deals damage, add its Damage Dice Roll an extra time to the damage. Raise the user’s Special Defense 1 Combat Stage.

movelist.name: Screech
movelist.effect: All Legal Targets have their Defense lowered 2 Combat Stages.

abilities.name: Electric Surge
abilities.effect: The Field becomes Electrified, as if affected by the Move Electric Terrain, for one full round.

abilities.name: Prime Fury
abilities.effect: The user becomes Enraged, and gains +1 Combat Stage in each of Attack and Special Attack.

abilities.name: Rocket
abilities.effect: The user may take their turn at the top of the round. Priority, Interrupt, or Reaction Moves or Abilities cannot be declared in response to the user’s turn.
